title: write_file
description: Create a new file or overwrite an existing file's entire contents. Path is relative to the repository root; parent directories are created automatically. For a small edit to an existing file, prefer apply_patch instead — it's safer and produces a clearer diff. Requires user confirmation unless the harness is running with --yolo/--auto.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.
